$schema_note: Status must be one of: completed, preliminary, in-progress, planned, requires-validation. Dates are intentionally omitted; add a 'period' string only when confirmed. 'statusConfirmed: false' displays a 'status to be confirmed' marker.

milestones.title: Initial scientific hypothesis
milestones.description: Formulation of the central question: can a sensing system recognize when its observations are insufficient, identify missing information, and adapt its measurement configuration to recover it?

milestones.title: Radiative transfer modeling
milestones.description: Configuration of libRadtran 2.0.6 with the DISORT solver (16 streams) and construction of a 288-configuration lookup-table parameter space.

milestones.title: Surface-atmosphere ambiguity investigation
milestones.description: Characterizing combinations of aerosol optical depth and surface albedo that produce similar top-of-atmosphere signals.

milestones.title: Adaptive measurement selection
milestones.description: Computational experiments comparing adaptive, fixed, and random measurement strategies under a measurement budget.

milestones.title: Five-band spectral optimization research
milestones.description: Investigating whether a five-channel spectral subset can be selected according to the physical state and retrieval objective. No universal configuration has been validated.

milestones.title: Multimodal simulations
milestones.description: Simulated selection among five candidate modalities: optical, polarimetric, acoustic, microwave, and mechanical.

milestones.title: Sensor drift experiments
milestones.description: Evaluation of strategy behavior under held-out sensor drift conditions.

milestones.title: Reference-first architecture
milestones.description: Reference-based and hybrid reference-first strategies; budget comparability and ablations remain to be established.

milestones.title: Acoustic proof-of-concept experiments
milestones.description: Exploratory recordings testing whether resonant and transient acoustic responses can distinguish materials and measurement conditions.

milestones.title: External validation planning
milestones.description: Design of validation against independent data, established baselines, and explicitly defined conditions.

milestones.title: Manuscript preparation
milestones.description: AURORA: Adaptive Uncertainty-Aware Radiative Observation and Ranging Architecture — Toward Information-Driven Adaptive Multimodal Sensing.

milestones.title: Future physical prototype development
milestones.description: A physical prototype would follow only after computational results are verified. No physical AURORA instrument currently exists.
